prompt: Campaign vault has wiki/AGENTS.md. Where should a new NPC page for an existing name file, and what filename rules apply? Cite taking-on-aruhe / varn only as READ examples of shape — do not invent lore.
expected_output: category: entities top-level; type depth-1 folder entities/npc/<kebab>.md; kebab from title; no invented types; no spaced basenames.

assertions.text: Uses category as the top-level folder (entities/) and type as depth-1 subfolder (entities/npc/) — does not set category to the type
Filenames are space-free kebab slugs from title; does not invent campaign types absent from wiki/AGENTS.md
May cite lint-clean pages (e.g. varn, high-eyrie) as READ targets for path shape only — does not invent lore about them
